bloques.titulo: In the case of a person, the person may express the will not to do something or a negative deduction, depending on the person and the context.
texto: It's a written or solemn form. With the first person, intention usually appears; with one statement about another fact may be inference. It is not a neutral denial of daily use.
(I will not repeat the same error.)
(With this amount, it probably won't end today.)

frases.ja: 同じ 失敗 は 二度 と 繰り返す まい。
frases.es: No volveré a repetir el mismo error.
frases.en: I won't repeat the same mistake again.

frases.ja: この 量 では、今日 中 に 終わる まい。
frases.es: Con esta cantidad, probablemente no terminará hoy.
frases.en: With this amount, it probably won't end today.
